title: The execution model: what runs, and in what order

questions.q: A node is on the canvas but nothing downstream uses it, and it is not an output. What happens?
questions.why: Execution walks back from output nodes, so it is never reached.

questions.q: What does the server report for a graph with no output node?
Two outputs exist, and one has an invalid ancestor. What happens?
options: The valid output still runs, and the other is dropped
The invalid node is skipped silently and its output still runs
questions.answer: The valid output still runs, and the other is dropped
questions.why: validate_prompt only fails when no output is left, and it reports node_errors for the rest.

questions.q: Why can a node with a lazy input be visited twice?
options: On the first visit it says which inputs it needs and goes back in the list as pending
Because the graph has a cycle
questions.answer: On the first visit it says which inputs it needs and goes back in the list as pending
questions.why: check_lazy_status names the inputs, make_input_strong_link adds blockers, and the result is PENDING.

options: The order among ready nodes, so results appear sooner
questions.answer: The order among ready nodes, so results appear sooner
